paragraphs: His son R' Gamliel: Jerusalem Talmud Peah, beginning of chapter 1 [additional locator: ב].[^1]

notes.text: The additional ב may denote folio2, but its pagination is not established. The two stored Guggenheimer Peah1:1 scalars give Gamliel ben Ininya with Rabban in one occurrence and Rabbi in another. The supplied father name Inyona (איניונא) differs from איניניא; retain it, son direction, and unresolved R' before Gamliel rather than choosing a conflicting full title.
